dogecoin.text: Markus clarifies that he is no longer involved in the Dogecoin project and is speaking as a simple member of the community. He also criticizes the trolls who oversell DOGE and cryptocurrencies in general. https://t.co/lBRjDghKhz

@BillyM2k, co-founder of Dogecoin (DOGE), announces that he now holds just 220,000 DOGE, or less than €35,000 at current prices

The announcement was made on December 27, 2021 via a tweet https://t.co/5XmzvZcVog
